notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Dear factory managers,
 
Thank you for all the comments and suggestions. We have just released a new patch with the following changes:
 

Parts increase their stats with tuning by 10-15% for each level.
Fixed the achievement for obtaining all bodies.
Fix for deleting a game - it will now be properly deleted from the Steam cloud.
Fixed a minor error in the workers’ salaries calculation for the first year (they did not get salary for the first week of the game).
Minor balancing updates - Black Market jobs rewards are increased.
Made the offer to buy elixirs appear after year 5 for the first time.
Made some advertisements come later, so that the more expensive ones are not available from the start.

 
Let us know what you think. Your feedback helps us make the game better!
 
Yours, Epic Devs

notes.title: Patch 1.01 released
notes.content:
Dear builders,

we thank you for your honest reviews, even though most are negative.
This helps us a lot to see what you do not like, and change it the way you like it.

With the patch that now got live, we have applied the following changes:


shortened and lowered volume for chewing, munching, slurping
fixed an issue, where volume did reset itself to maximum
added 16 more contracts for the first decade [Balance]
decreased salaries and level up costs by 20 percent [Balance]
fixed an issue, where achievements did not count properly, please load the game with the new update, this will give you the earned achievements


Our next tasks until Monday


more and better contracts
boost the stats gained from tuning items
change the concept of defects/bugs


Stay tuned and help us make the game better and better. And hopefully, someday you will like us more :)

Yours, Epic Devs

notes.title: Black Market, Factory Skins and Release Date
notes.content:
Dear lovely Epic Car Factory producers,

the exclusive access to our Epic Car Factory Beta continues a bit longer.

Meanwhile let us present you all the new things that we accomplished until now and starts with the Black Market.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31497688/d42fbb175700050ec6dc980b023af8164909eb40.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31497688/992da0af5550eda423201412e187d4ab2408e83e.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31497688/6fdfe02904b0f7fef08e2d46eb92a7c83761cd68.png

The Black Market is a feature in Epic Car Factory, where you can do a lot of new things such as:


    Produce special cars for governments
    Produce special cars for the mob
    Produce other very special cars
    Develop new special parts
    Industrial Espionage
    Very Special Favors


The Black Market is a huge part of new content to Epic Car Factory, and while we want to give you the best experience, you can see here some funny patch notes of fails happening in development:


    Rival companies won't show Black Market cars any more
    No Black Market cars on the street
    Car selection windows for Yearly Awards and Races will no longer show Black Market cars


Now that all this is cleared and the bugs are fixed, you can find the new content in BETA ACCESS.

The second important thing we wanted to share with you, are new skins for the factories. Even though it is just cosmetically, I believe some of you will find them really interesting and worth trying on their factories. Here is one of them:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31497688/6ed54610ad57c66d7fb7c962d08ba5bd9b06abba.png

Last but not least, some of you have probably noticed that we moved the release date from first quarter to the 10th of April. We do want to present you a game, that is flawless, and for that we do need that few extra days. 

As you can see, we do work quite a lot and are nearly there,

every purchase includes INSTANT BETA ACCESS. A second entry will appear in your library called Epic Car Factory Pre-Purchase DLC and will stay there until the full release of the game.

And naturally helps us to continue delivering awesome stuff to you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31497688/e98c9cb5bbe176c58b359014775ae2271d6793c8.png
Patience,
Your Epic Car Factory Team
